title: EFC Ontological Foundations v1.0: The Co-Primary Structure
description: Establishes the ontological basis for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) by arguing that energy-flow and entropy are co-primary, differentiated aspects of a single pre-geometric potential that separates at the Planck transition. Resolves circularity in monistic ontologies and integrates coherently with EFC’s Core Lock dynamics, EBE epistemic framework, and RCMP measurement protocol, aligning with insights from Wheeler, Verlinde, and Prigogine.

beta_function.description: Constant beta-function in the Core Lock RG-flow connecting differentiation dynamics to entropy change; implies exponential relaxation from the pre-Planck undifferentiated potential to post-Planck differentiated regimes.

information_length.description: Accumulated phase (information length) defined by the entropy flow f(S); proposed invariant bridging the undifferentiated potential to observables via projection laws.

correlated_variation_signature.description: Predicted correlation for any time or environment variation of fundamental constants: log–log slopes between pairs of constants are constant across epochs and datasets.

key_results.main_finding: Energy-flow and entropy are co-primary, differentiated aspects of a single pre-geometric potential, providing a non-circular ontological foundation that coherently integrates with all EFC sub-frameworks.
parameters_tested: Integration with EFC (Core Lock, EBE, RCMP)

sealed_predictions.statement: If any fundamental constants vary over time or environment, their variations will be mutually correlated with constant log–log slopes between pairs (d ln C_i / d ln C_j = const) across epochs and instruments.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Detect statistically significant epoch- or environment-dependent changes in the slopes d ln C_i / d ln C_j, or uncorrelated variations where one constant varies while others do not, beyond systematic uncertainties.

sealed_predictions.statement: An invariant information length Φ reconstructed from independent observables via appropriate projection laws will agree across probes within uncertainties.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Reconstruct Φ from multiple independent datasets (e.g., different cosmological or laboratory observables) and find irreconcilable discrepancies exceeding combined uncertainties and plausible systematics.

kill_criteria: KC1: Observation of time or environment variation in two or more fundamental constants where the log–log slope d ln C_i / d ln C_j is not constant (varies with redshift, environment, or dataset) beyond systematic uncertainties.

KC2: Robust detection of variation in one fundamental constant with no corresponding co-variation in others, such that no fixed proportionality (constant log–log slope) can reconcile the data across independent probes.

KC3: High-confidence evidence for a primordial, ontologically primary pre-geometric grid/lattice (e.g., persistent Lorentz-violating dispersion or preferred directions implying a fundamental lattice scale) that cannot be interpreted as emergent and that supplies a non-circular monistic ontology.

KC4: Cross-probe reconstructions of the information-length invariant Φ that are mutually inconsistent beyond combined uncertainties, indicating the proposed invariant bridging ontology to observables does not exist.
epistemicStatus: Layer C - Coherence argument, not empirical claim
